product_overview: A local-first desktop productivity dashboard that combines a clock, weather, finance tracker, study tracker with timer, calendar, and appearance settings — all data persisted to localStorage for single-user use.
core_goals: See the current time and open an enlarged full-screen clock for focus or presentation.
View local weather for a configured city and adjust weather settings.
Create finance categories, log income/expenses, and view daily and cumulative financial summaries.
Create and track study topics with sub-tasks and use a timer to record study sessions.
Create and manage calendar events on a monthly grid and inspect or delete events.
Customize the app appearance (theme, colors, fonts, background) and switch UI language.
Navigate quickly between app sections using the sidebar.

features.name: Clock Widget & Full-Screen Clock
features.description: Show current time on the home dashboard and allow users to open a full-screen clock view and return to the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View current time and date on home dashboard clock widget -> Click clock widget to navigate to full-screen clock view (/clock) -> View enlarged time and date in full-screen -> Click anywhere on full-screen clock to return to home (navigate to /)
Navigate to /clock -> View full-screen clock with configured timezone and background -> Click anywhere to return to /

features.name: Clock Customization Settings
features.description: Adjust clock appearance and timezone so the clock display matches user preference.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Select clock text color -> Toggle bold clock text -> Toggle clock box background style -> Save settings -> Navigate to /clock -> See updated clock appearance and timezone reflected in full-screen view
Navigate to /settings -> Select timezone for clock display -> Save settings -> Navigate to /clock -> Verify clock shows time for selected timezone

features.name: Weather Widget
features.description: Display current weather (city, temperature, humidity, feels-like) on the home dashboard using a configured OpenWeatherMap API key and city.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Enter OpenWeatherMap API key and city -> Save settings -> Navigate to / -> See weather city name, temperature, humidity, and feels-like temperature on home page
Navigate to / -> View current temperature and weather conditions on home page

features.name: Finance Category Management
features.description: Create, view, open, and delete finance categories to organize transactions.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance -> Click to create a new finance category -> Enter category name and save -> View list of existing categories and see the new category listed
Navigate to /finance -> View list of existing categories -> Open a category to view details -> Delete the category -> See category removed from list

features.name: Finance Transaction Logging
features.description: Add income and expense transactions inside categories using preset or custom amounts and optional notes, and manage transaction history.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance -> Select a category to open its detail view -> Toggle between Income and Expense type -> Click a preset amount button to add transaction -> See transaction appear in the category history and totals update
Navigate to /finance -> Select a category to open its detail view -> Toggle to Expense type -> Enter a custom amount and optional reason/note -> Save transaction -> View transaction in history
Navigate to /finance -> Open category transaction history -> Delete a transaction from history -> See transaction removed and totals update

features.name: Finance Summary Dashboard
features.description: Show calculated financial summaries including today's income, today's expense, accumulated totals, and net balance on finance and home dashboards.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance -> Add one or more income and expense transactions across categories -> View today's income total, today's expense total, accumulated income and expense, and total net balance update accordingly
Navigate to / -> View finance summary widgets reflecting today's income, today's expense, and total net balance

features.name: Study Topics Management
features.description: Create study topics and sub-tasks, mark progress with checkboxes, and view progress percentages per topic.
user_flows: Navigate to /study -> Click to add a new study topic -> Enter topic title and save -> View new topic in the list with a progress percentage
Navigate to /study -> Open a topic to see sub-tasks -> Add sub-tasks under the topic -> Check a sub-task checkbox to mark completion -> See topic progress percentage update
Navigate to /study -> Open a topic -> Delete a sub-task -> See sub-task removed and topic progress update -> Delete the topic -> See topic removed from list

features.name: Study Timer
features.description: Run a timer for study sessions tied to a selected subject and save the session when stopped.
user_flows: Navigate to /study -> Select a subject/topic for the study session -> Start the study timer -> View elapsed time updating in real-time -> Stop the timer to end the session -> See session saved confirmation
Navigate to /study -> Attempt to start the study timer without selecting a subject -> See validation preventing start or prompt to select a subject

features.name: Calendar Event Creation
features.description: Create events on the monthly calendar with type, name, date, time, optional notes, and quick-start option.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendar -> Click a date on the calendar grid to select it -> Choose an event type icon -> Enter event name -> Select event time from presets or enter custom time -> Optionally add notes -> Toggle quick-start option -> Save the event -> See event indicator appear on the selected date
Navigate to /calendar -> Click a date -> Create and save an event without notes -> See event indicator appear on the date

features.name: Calendar View & Event Management
features.description: Browse the monthly calendar, view event indicators and details, and delete individual or multiple events.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendar -> Navigate between months using arrow buttons -> Click month/year header to open month-year picker -> Select a month/year -> View month grid for selected month

Navigate to /calendar -> View event indicators (dots) on dates with events -> Click an event indicator to see event details popup -> View event name, type, time, and notes in popup -> Delete individual event from popup -> See indicator removed
Navigate to /calendar -> Select multiple events -> Perform bulk delete -> Confirm bulk deletion -> See selected events removed from calendar

features.name: Theme & Appearance Settings
features.description: Change theme, primary color, font, and see UI update immediately to match chosen appearance.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Toggle between Light Mode and Dark Mode -> Save settings -> Navigate to / -> See UI colors update according to selected theme
Navigate to /settings -> Select a primary accent color and choose application font -> Save settings -> See UI update immediately with new accent and font

features.name: Background & Wallpaper Settings
features.description: Set the application background using upload, direct image URL, video, or a solid color and clear or save changes.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Select background type = image -> Upload an image file as background -> Save settings -> Navigate to / -> See uploaded image applied as background
Navigate to /settings -> Select background type = image -> Enter a direct image URL as background -> Save settings -> Navigate to / -> See image from URL applied as background
Navigate to /settings -> Select background type = color -> Select a solid background color -> Save settings -> Navigate to / -> See solid color background applied
Navigate to /settings -> Clear current background -> Save settings -> Navigate to / -> See default background restored

features.name: Language Toggle
features.description: Switch application UI language between Thai and English.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the language toggle button to switch to Thai -> See all UI text update to Thai
Navigate to / -> Click the language toggle button to switch to English -> See all UI text update to English

features.name: Sidebar Navigation
features.description: Use the sidebar to jump between main app sections while seeing a live clock in the sidebar.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Use sidebar link to navigate to /finance -> View finance page and current time in sidebar bottom
Navigate to / -> Use sidebar link to navigate to /study -> Use sidebar link to navigate to /calendar -> Use sidebar link to navigate to /settings -> Use sidebar link to return to /
